title: Module review
subtitle: Everything from Italy
objectives: Link Italy's regions to their grapes

steps.prompt: Match each wine to its grape.
steps.explanation: Italy's great wines are made from native grapes.

steps.prompt: What led to the creation of the IGT category?
steps.explanation: Super Tuscans made great wines outside DOC rules.

steps.prompt: Vino Nobile di Montepulciano is made from the Montepulciano grape.
steps.explanation: Not true. It's made mostly from Sangiovese in the Tuscan town of Montepulciano.

steps.prompt: Etna's main red grape is Nerello ____.
steps.explanation: Nerello Mascalese gives Etna's pale, elegant reds.

steps.title: What you learned
points: DOCG, DOC, IGT and Vino rank Italian wine
Piedmont and Tuscany lead with Nebbiolo and Sangiovese
The north-east is fresh and Alpine; the south is volcanic and warm
Italy's strength is its hundreds of native grapes
